By leveraging advanced machine learning algorithms, multimodal AI can provide a comprehensive understanding of a patient's health status, enabling personalized treatment plans and early disease detection. This holistic approach not only improves clinical outcomes but also supports the development of patient digital twins, which simulate individual health scenarios for better prediction and management of conditions. This project focuses on the segmentation of brain tumors in 3D MRI images using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models.
